decisions.reason: The lever handle family sits within the firm's core metal handle, finishing and ergonomic knowledge, so management can read its early results and refine the line instead of withdrawing it.
The multifunctional lever extends the firm's barrier-free and ergonomic know-how, and in-house development lets the firm turn market feedback into improvements, which supports keeping it.
This lever handle line fits the established coordinated families, and although the website shows little evidence of strong traction, keeping it costs little.
The 1289 collection won a German Design Award, has its own website page and builds on core competencies, so it is a validated flagship to retain.
The bronze patina finish uses the firm's proprietary finishing expertise and broadens the coordinated range at low marginal cost.
